$comment: Fixture. Deliberately fails C5 in both ways. I1 uses the rejected 'Current' suffix, which is redundant because a bare name already denotes present state. I2 declares a capability with the 'Supported' suffix but does not mark the rule as list-valued, and a declared capability is always a set.
title: Fixture - C5 naming conventions
